The '''Glassferra system''' was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Glassferran]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Mindor" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Glassferra [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-9.<ref name="TEA" />
